messages:
luke_sales: PioneerGrid POC just hit a hard CISO blocker. They want BYOK KMS + explicit egress guarantee (no data leaves EU region) before legal signs the contract. Need exec-level unblock, procurement looped. Who can join an exec bridge today? :exclamation:
anya_se: Thanks — quick context: their workload is 200 qps peak, short sequences. They want our Private (VPC) with BYOK + HSM attestation and a documented egress flow. Tech-wise we can run on Dedicated or Private. The blocker is legal asking for a KMS attestation doc + timeline for on-prem package if needed.
ramon_eng_infra: We can provide KMS BYOK but HSM attestation will take a week to generate (security review + audit statement). We can fast-track a provisional attestation + commit to provide formal doc in 7 business days. Need approval from infra leads for expedited priority.
tia_sales_ops: Asking legal whether provisional attestation + signed SOC2 addendum is acceptable as interim. Also what discount/commit we need to close if we promise the 7-day delivery? Procurement asked for a tradeoff.
marta_vp_sales: @luke_sales please escalate — I can join an exec bridge at 1600 UTC today. We should offer a short-term workaround (hosted w/ EU region + contract clause) if they need immediate demo, then deliver BYOK on Private. What is the minimum SLA we can promise for the interim?
sarah_custsuccess: For the POC demo we can route all traffic to eu-west-2 hosted nodes with enforced egress block and give them a signed Data Flow diagram. That removes immediate egress worry for the demo. But they explicitly require BYOK before prod.
anya_se: Also note: their CISO asked for throughput SLO (p99 < 120ms) at 200 qps. Our Dedicated config meets that on paper; need capacity reservation. Ramon — can you confirm dedicated pool sizing and time to allocate?
ramon_eng_infra: Dedicated pool + reserved capacity for 200 qps p99 120ms — we need 3 x a40 equivalents for redundancy; provisioning ETA 3 business days if we spin up Dedicated in EU. If they insist on Private/on-prem we need infra team + legal to sign the on-prem addendum — that’s 10+ business days.
ops-bot: New internal ticket created: INFRA-8672 — "PioneerGrid BYOK attestation + dedicated pool priority" assigned to ramon_eng_infra. ETA fields: provisional attest 3 business days, formal attest 7 business days, dedicated pool 3 business days.
luke_sales: Good. Customer is pushing for a firm date on the BYOK attestation. Marta — will you lead the exec bridge and authorize prioritized infra work? I can get legal on the phone.
marta_vp_sales: I'll lead. Action items for the bridge: 1) commit to provisional attestation timeline, 2) offer hosted EU demo path as interim, 3) outline commercial concession (2-3 month trial discount) to get signoff. @tia_sales_ops prepare a shaped concession we can offer.
tia_sales_ops: Drafting concession now — suggested offer: 30% off for first 90 days on committed Dedicated usage or 3 months free on hosted with no-penalty exit if BYOK not delivered in 7 days. Sending draft in 30m.
anya_se: I'll prepare a one-page technical statement covering: BYOK process, KMS flow, egress controls, and performance obs (benchmarks). Will post as PDF in the bridge.
ramon_eng_infra: I'll mark INFRA-8672 high priority and start provisioning. If legal needs a short system-level proof: I can provide the KMS key wrap flow + sample attestation template we use for other customers.
sarah_custsuccess: I'll coordinate customer comms and schedule the exec bridge for 1600 UTC. Luke — share the customer PO/attendees so I can include them.
luke_sales: Attendees: PioneerGrid CISO (marcus.c), CTO (jess), procurement (anna.p). PO is 8793. I'll DM the docs to Sarah.
marta_vp_sales: Perfect. If infra can meet provisional 3-day attestation, we're aligned. We'll escalate to execs on our side if legal needs to change verbiage.
ops-bot: INFRA-8672 updated: priority=high, provisional_attest_eta=3d, formal_attest_eta=7d, dedicated_pool_eta=3d. Slack reminders set for 48h and 72h.
anya_se: One note for the bridge: prepare this snippet to show the customer (copyable):
```
Redwood BYOK flow:
1) Customer creates CMK in their KMS (supported: AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure KeyVault)
2) Customer provides key policy and allowlist for Redwood service principals
3) Redwood binds key via Key Wrap for model runtime; no plaintext keys stored
4) Audit logs and access proofs provided (sample attestation)
```
luke_sales: Thanks all — meeting at 1600 UTC. Will post bridge link in 15m. Please update INFRA-8672 with any changes. :thumbsup:
